hypothesis: Rust supervisor short-lived cleanup lock does not protect the serving socket pathname for its whole lifetime; an external rename permits a second supervisor bind while the first remains live. TS proper-lockfile lifetime lease excludes the rival.
approach: Add a supervisor-lifetime {socket}.lock directory lease in pa-daemon socket.rs/supervisor.rs; acquire before prepare/bind, refresh 1s from dedicated joinable thread, 5s stale reclaim, 600x25ms retries, detect lock inode displacement, fence accept loop on compromise, skip compromised cleanup, stop/join refresher before inode-safe release. Add minimal pa-core LockDir::into_path ownership transfer. Expand two same-socket force-kill restart fixture reconnect waits 5s->20s to cover 15s lease acquisition +5s margin.
